Hi Maya — thanks for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of issue:
- Your production inference latency spiked from ~120ms P95 to ~1.2s starting 2026-07-15 07:30 PDT; sustained for ~2 hours and impacted the payment routing service.
- The hosted tier exhausted your auto-burst capacity and requests were queued; SDK retries amplified load.

Immediate asks from CardioTech (from call):
1) Fast-tracked evaluation of Dedicated capacity (predictable throughput + isolation).
2) An estimate of time-to-provision and cost given your current QPS/seq-length mix.
3) Any quick mitigations we can apply on hosted while Dedicated is stood up.

What we (Redwood) will do next: 
- Vivek: confirm whether current model variant and quantization profile are safe to keep during migration and provide rough capacity sizing (ETA today).
- Laura: send procurement checklist and draft quote for Dedicated, include rough timelines for SLA/ops onboarding (ETA EOD tomorrow).
- I'll share the logs you dropped in the Drive and propose a shortcanary plan that minimizes risk.

Attachments I referenced: capacity-logs-20260715.txt (you uploaded), preliminary quote (attached draft).

Proposed next meeting: 2026-07-16 11:00 PT to review sizing and PO ramp. Confirm if that works.

Ben / team — I pulled the logs and ran a quick simulation. High-level notes: 

- Root cause signal: sustained concurrent sequence-length increase + client retry storm. The hosted autoscaler hit configured burst limits and started queuing at the gateway.
- Quick mitigation (can be applied in <1 hour): dial client-side retry backoff to linear 500ms -> 1.5s, enable prefix KV caching for the payment-routing model to reduce repeated context, and apply a temporary rate-limit rule scoped to the payment-routing route. I'll share the CLI commands.

Rough Dedicated sizing (ballpark):
- Model: small LLM variant you run (8B quantized)
- Target headroom: 2.5x baseline peak QPS to avoid immediate saturation during spikes
- Suggested pool: 4x A10-equivalent GPUs (dedicated pool), estimated sustained throughput ~3k tokens/s, expected P95 latency ~140–180ms.
- Time to provision (with infra approval & signed PO): 3–5 business days for Dedicated baseline; faster (48–72h) if we use pre-approved instance profile and fast-track SLA.

I'll prepare a short bench report (sample load tests) and an infra-runbook for provisioning. Need confirmation on their expected peak QPS and preferred start date to firm up the quote.

—Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

- Contract notes: standard MSA + data handling addendum (we can scope retention & logging controls for CardioTech).
- Next legal step: we can route a short-form SOW/PO + DocuSign; I can share the draft link now.
